title: Infinity Swirls
description: An abstract painting featuring two large interlocking spiral forms creating an infinity-like pattern. The left spiral blends purples and pinks while the right spiral combines vibrant blues and pinks, with visible thick brushstrokes and scattered small yellow and white accents on a white background.
prompt: Abstract painting with two large interlocking infinity-style spirals, left spiral in magenta and purple tones, right spiral in cyan and blue tones, energetic swirling brushwork with thick impasto texture, small yellow and white paint accents scattered throughout, vibrant color flow on white canvas background, expressive contemporary art style.
